description: BPSC TRE Computer Science Model Test Paper 02 containing 150 questions across Language, General Studies, and Computer Science.

questions.questionText: He is _______ honest officer working in the education department.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The word 'honest' begins with a silent 'h' and a vowel sound, so the indefinite article 'an' is used.

questions.questionText: Mount Everest is _______ highest peak in the world.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Superlative degree adjectives like 'highest' take the definite article 'the'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an electronic gadget?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A blackboard is a traditional writing surface and not an electronic device.

questions.questionText: Sister's daughter is called:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A sister's or brother's daughter is called a niece.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a reptile?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A sparrow is an avian species (bird), whereas lizards and snakes are reptiles.

questions.questionText: If yesterday was Friday, what day will it be the day after tomorrow?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: If yesterday was Friday, today is Saturday, tomorrow is Sunday, and the day after tomorrow will be Monday.

questions.questionText: Choose the antonym of the word "ARROGANT":
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both 'Humble' and 'Modest' serve as antonyms for 'Arrogant', making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: November comes before the month of:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: November directly precedes December in the calendar year.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'अनु' उपसर्ग से नहीं बना है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'अनपढ़' शब्द में हिंदी का 'अन' उपसर्ग लगा है, संस्कृत का 'अनु' नहीं।

questions.questionText: 'य, र, ल, व' किस वर्ग के व्यंजन हैं?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: हिंदी वर्णमाला में य, र, ल, व को अन्तःस्थ व्यंजन कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से महाप्राण ध्वनि कौन-सी है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रत्येक स्पर्श वर्ग का दूसरा और चौथा वर्ण महाप्राण होता है; 'ख' कवर्ग का दूसरा वर्ण है।

questions.questionText: 'सूर्योदय' शब्द में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: सूर्य + उदय = सूर्योदय (अ + उ = ओ), जो गुण स्वर संधि का नियम है।

questions.questionText: 'लंबोदर' शब्द किस प्रकार का शब्द है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: लंबोदर (लंबा + उदर) अपने सामान्य अर्थ को छोड़कर गणेश जी के लिए रूढ़ हो गया है, अतः योगरूढ़ है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से भाववाचक संज्ञा कौन-सी है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: मित्रता, बचपन और सुंदरता तीनों ही भाव, गुण या अवस्था को व्यक्त करने वाली भाववाचक संज्ञाएँ हैं।

questions.questionText: 'पेड़ से पत्ते गिरते हैं।' इस वाक्य में 'पेड़ से' में कौन-सा कारक है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जहाँ किसी वस्तु का किसी स्थान से अलग होने का भाव हो, वहाँ अपादान कारक होता है।

questions.questionText: 'अनुराग' शब्द का सही विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'अनुराग' का विपरीतार्थक शब्द 'विराग' होता है।

questions.questionText: 'चक्षु' किसका पर्यायवाची शब्द है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: आँख, नयन और लोचन तीनों ही 'चक्षु' के पर्यायवाची शब्द हैं।

questions.questionText: 'जिसकी उपमा न दी जा सके' वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द होगा:
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जिसकी कोई उपमा न दी जा सके, उसे 'अनुपम' कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText: 'अंगूठा दिखाना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'अंगूठा दिखाना' मुहावरे का अर्थ समय पर साफ मना कर देना या इनकार करना होता है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए:
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: मानक वर्तनी के अनुसार शुद्ध रूप 'आशीर्वाद' है।

questions.questionText: "चरण कमल बंदौ हरिराई" में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: यहाँ चरणों पर कमल का सीधा अभेद आरोप होने से रूपक अलंकार है।

questions.questionText: 'यथाशक्ति' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रथम पद अव्यय 'यथा' (शक्ति के अनुसार) होने के कारण इसमें अव्ययीभाव समास है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से तद्भव शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'आग' तद्भव शब्द है, जिसका तत्सम रूप 'अग्नि' होता है।

questions.questionText: 'जो सब कुछ जानता हो' वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द है:
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: सब कुछ जानने वाले के लिए एक शब्द 'सर्वज्ञ' प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.questionText: 'वह धीरे-धीरे चलता है।' वाक्य में 'धीरे-धीरे' क्या है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'धीरे-धीरे' चलने की क्रिया की विशेषता बता रहा है, अतः यह रीतिवाचक क्रियाविशेषण है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से स्त्रीलिंग शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: पानी और दही पुल्लिंग हैं, जबकि 'नदी' स्त्रीलिंग शब्द है।

questions.questionText: 'आँखें फेर लेना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'आँखें फेर लेना' का प्रचलित अर्थ उदासीन हो जाना अथवा प्रतिकूल व्यवहार करना होता है।

questions.questionText: 'प्रत्यक्ष' का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या होगा?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रति + अक्षि मिलकर यण् संधि के नियम से 'प्रत्यक्ष' बनता है।

questions.questionText: रचना की दृष्टि से वाक्य के कितने मुख्य भेद होते हैं?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: रचना के आधार पर वाक्य के तीन भेद होते हैं: सरल वाक्य, संयुक्त वाक्य और मिश्र वाक्य।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विराम चिह्न 'अल्पविराम' कहलाता है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: हिंदी विराम चिह्नों में कामा (,) को अल्पविराम कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText: The sum of the first 20 odd natural numbers is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The sum of the first n odd natural numbers is given by n^2. Here, n = 20, so 20^2 = 400.

questions.questionText: A train 150 metres long passes a pole in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance / Time = 150 m / 15 s = 10 m/s. Converting to km/h: 10 * (18/5) = 36 km/h.

questions.questionText: If $a:b = 2:3$ and $b:c = 4:5$, then $a:b:c$ is equal to:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Multiplying the ratios to balance b: a:b = 8:12 and b:c = 12:15, which yields a:b:c = 8:12:15.

questions.questionText: The difference between two whole numbers is 66. The ratio of the two numbers is 2:5. The two numbers are:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let numbers be 2x and 5x. 5x - 2x = 3x = 66 => x = 22. Numbers are 44 and 110.

questions.questionText: A sum of money doubles itself in 5 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Simple Interest = Principal. R = (SI * 100) / (P * T) = (P * 100) / (P * 5) = 20%.

questions.questionText: In a parallelogram $ABCD$, angle $A$ and angle $B$ are in the ratio 1:2. Find angle $A$:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles in a parallelogram are supplementary: x + 2x = 180° => 3x = 180° => x = 60°.

questions.questionText: If the radius of a circle is increased by 50%, then its area is increased by:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The distance between Delhi and Agra is 200 km. If an average speed of 90 km/hr is maintained for 120 km and 40 km/hr for the remaining distance, what is the total travel time?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Time for first 120 km = 120/90 = 4/3 hr = 1 hr 20 min. Remaining distance = 80 km; time = 80/40 = 2 hr. Total time = 3 hr 20 min.

questions.questionText: If $x$ and $y$ are inversely proportional, which of the following relations holds true?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Inverse proportionality means x ∝ 1/y, which translates to xy = constant.

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper sells an article for Rs. 720 and incurs a 10% loss. At what price must he sell it to gain 10%?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The human eye forms the real inverted image of an object at its:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The crystalline lens of the human eye focuses incoming light rays onto the retina.

questions.questionText: Which chemical acid is known as the "King of Chemicals"?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sulphuric acid (H2SO4) is widely termed the King of Chemicals due to its extensive industrial utility.

questions.questionText: Asexual reproduction takes place through budding in which of the following organisms?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both Yeast and Hydra reproduce asexually by developing buds, making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Which instrument is used to measure electric current in a circuit?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: An ammeter is connected in series in an electric circuit to measure electric current.

questions.questionText: Which of the following medicines is commonly used for neutralizing excess stomach acid (indigestion)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Antacids are basic compounds that neutralize excess stomach acidity.

questions.questionText: Which gas is responsible for the greenhouse effect and global warming in the largest proportion?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide contributes the largest share among anthropogenic greenhouse gases causing global warming.

questions.questionText: What is the phenomenon of splitting white light into its seven constituent colors called?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The splitting of polychromatic white light into its constituent spectral colors when passing through a prism is dispersion.

questions.questionText: Which gland in the human body is referred to as the 'Master Gland'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The pituitary gland controls the secretions of several other endocrine glands, earning the title Master Gland.

questions.questionText: An isotropic source of 2 candela produces total luminous flux equal to:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Total luminous flux from an isotropic source is 4π * I = 4π * 2 = 8π lumens.

questions.questionText: What is the primary observation point of India's solar mission Aditya-L1?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 is placed in a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth Lagrangian point L1 to observe solar dynamics.

questions.questionText: When is 'World Earth Day' observed globally?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: World Earth Day is celebrated every year on 22 April to support environmental protection.

questions.questionText: Topographical maps of India are surveyed, drawn, and published by:
questions.optionC: National Atlas and Thematic Mapping Organisation
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Survey of India is the national mapping agency entrusted with surveying and topographical map production.

questions.questionText: Which country is NOT a member of the G7 intergovernmental forum?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Neither Russia, India, nor China is a member of the Group of Seven (G7), making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: What is the name of ISRO's human spaceflight mission designed to send astronauts to low Earth orbit?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Gaganyaan is the Indian crewed orbital spacecraft program developed by ISRO.

questions.questionText: Which state in India has the highest percentage of urbanization as per the latest census data?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: As per Census 2011, Goa is the most urbanized state in India with over 62% urban population.

questions.questionText: In which district of Bihar is the highest literacy rate recorded?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rohtas district holds the highest overall literacy rate in Bihar as per Census 2011.

questions.questionText: Someshwar Fort and hill range in Bihar are situated in which district?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Someshwar Fort and hilly tract are located in the northern border region of West Champaran district.

questions.questionText: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bihar" due to its recurring flooding?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Kosi River changes its course frequently and brings widespread flooding, earning the moniker 'Sorrow of Bihar'.

questions.questionText: The Kakolat waterfall is located in which district of Bihar?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Kakolat Falls is situated on the Kakolat hill in Nawada district of Bihar.

questions.questionText: The South Peninsular Plateau of India forms a part of which ancient supercontinent?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Peninsular Plateau of India is geologically part of the ancient Gondwana shield.

questions.questionText: Who first described the Revolt of 1857 as the 'First Indian War of Independence'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vinayak Damodar Savarkar authored 'The Indian War of Independence 1857' framing the revolt as India's first national uprising.

questions.questionText: Who led the Revolt of 1857 in Bihar against the British colonial forces?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Babu Kunwar Singh (Jagdishpur), his brother Amar Singh, and Pir Ali Khan (Patna) were all prominent leaders in Bihar during 1857.

questions.questionText: Who persuaded Mahatma Gandhi to visit Champaran in 1917 to inspect indigo farmers' conditions?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Raj Kumar Shukla persistently met Gandhi during the 1916 Lucknow session and convinced him to visit Champaran.

questions.questionText: Who founded the 'Satyashodhak Samaj' in 1873?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj in Pune to liberate oppressed classes and promote education.

questions.questionText: Who was the first President of the Indian National Congress (1885)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee presided over the first session of the INC held in Bombay in December 1885.

questions.questionText: Who founded the 'Forward Bloc' political party in 1939 after resigning from Congress?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose formed the All India Forward Bloc within the national movement in 1939.

questions.questionText: In which year was the 'Bihar Provincial Congress Committee' formed with its headquarters at Patna?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bihar Provincial Congress Committee was formally constituted in 1908 under the presidency of Sir Ali Imam.

questions.questionText: Who established the 'Sadaqat Ashram' in Patna during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Maulana Mazharul Haque constructed Sadaqat Ashram on Patna-Danapur Road in 1921.

questions.questionText: Who was known by the title "Grand Old Man of India"?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji was revered as the Grand Old Man of India for his lifelong political and economic contributions.

questions.questionText: Who was appointed as the 'Commander in Chief' by Birsa Munda during the Ulgulan?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Birsa Munda appointed Gaya Munda as the chief commander of his armed forces during the tribal revolt.

questions.questionText: Which logic gate gives an output of 1 only when all its inputs are equal to 0?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A NOR gate evaluates to 1 exclusively when every input is 0.

questions.questionText: The Boolean expression $(A + B)(A + C)$ simplifies to:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: By distributive law: (A + B)(A + C) = AA + AC + AB + BC = A(1 + C + B) + BC = A + BC.

questions.questionText: What is the 2's complement of the binary number 101100?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 1's complement of 101100 is 010011. Adding 1 yields 010100.

questions.questionText: A full adder can be realized using:
questions.optionA: Two half adders and one OR gate
questions.optionB: Two half adders and one AND gate
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A full adder is constructed using two half adders and a single OR gate to combine the intermediate carry outputs.

questions.questionText: How many flip-flops are minimum required to construct a MOD-12 asynchronous counter?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: To count up to 12 states, 2^n >= 12 requires n = 4 flip-flops (since 2^3 = 8 < 12 and 2^4 = 16 >= 12).

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of the "don't care" condition ($X$) in Karnaugh maps (K-Maps)?
questions.optionA: It must strictly be set to 0
questions.optionB: It can be assigned 0 or 1 to achieve maximum grouping and simpler boolean equations
questions.optionC: It causes race conditions in circuits
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Don't care terms represent unused input combinations that can be treated as 1 or 0 to enlarge cell groupings.

questions.questionText: Convert the hexadecimal number (2A5)$_{16}$ to its octal equivalent:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 2A5 in hex = 0010 1010 0101 in binary. Grouping in 3s from right: 001 010 100 101 = 1 2 4 5 in octal = (1245)8.

questions.questionText: The register in a CPU that holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched is the:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Program Counter (PC) stores the memory location of the next sequential instruction.

questions.questionText: In DMA (Direct Memory Access) data transfers, data is transferred directly between:
questions.optionB: I/O device and Memory without continuous intervention of the CPU
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: DMA controllers transfer blocks of data directly between peripheral devices and main memory bypassing the CPU.

questions.questionText: What type of control signals are used to coordinate micro-operations in a hardwired control unit?
questions.optionA: Combinational logic gates and state flip-flops
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Hardwired control units rely on fixed combinational logic gates, decoders, and sequential counter flip-flops.

questions.questionText: Cache memory functions primarily on the fundamental principle of:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Cache effectiveness depends on spatial and temporal locality of reference displayed by programs.

questions.questionText: Which addressing mode is fastest because the operand is explicitly part of the instruction itself?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Immediate addressing embeds the operand directly in the instruction, avoiding memory access.

questions.questionText: In an associative cache mapping scheme with $m$ blocks in cache and $n$ blocks in main memory:
questions.optionA: Any block in memory can map to any line in cache
questions.optionB: Each block maps to only one fixed line in cache
questions.optionC: Blocks can map only to even-numbered lines
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fully associative cache allows any main memory block to be placed in any available cache line.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of buffer registers in I/O interfaces?
questions.optionB: To compensate for the speed mismatch between fast CPU and slower peripheral devices
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Buffer registers stage data to reconcile the operating speed disparity between the processor and slower I/O peripherals.

questions.questionText: Which bus expansion standard is used to connect high-speed peripherals directly to the processor?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI) bus connects high-speed controller cards directly to the host system bus.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The ternary operator evaluates 10 > 20 as false, returning and printing b (20).

questions.questionText:
What does the following pointer declaration mean in C?
int (*ptr)[10];
questions.optionB: Pointer to an array of 10 integers
questions.optionC: A function returning pointer to 10 integers
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Due to parentheses, ptr is declared as a single pointer to an array of 10 integers.

questions.explanation: Pointer arithmetic p + 2 points to index 2 of arr, and dereferencing gives arr[2] = 30.

questions.questionText: If a semicolon is omitted at the end of an executable statement in C++, the compiler generates:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C++ requires statements to terminate with a semicolon; omitting it raises a syntax compile error.

questions.questionText: Which of the following file stream modes in C++ truncates an existing file to length zero on opening?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both ios::trunc explicitly and ios::out (without app/ate) cause truncation of an existing file.

questions.questionText: In C++, which operator cannot be overloaded?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C++ does not permit overloading the scope resolution (::), member access (.), or ternary conditional (?:) operators.

questions.explanation: Calling factorial(a + 1) causes endless recursive calls leading to call-stack overflow and segmentation fault.

questions.questionText: What is the return type of the malloc() function in C?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: malloc() allocates raw uninitialized heap memory and returns a generic pointer of type void*.

questions.questionText: What is a "friend function" in C++?
questions.optionA: A member function that has access to only public data
questions.optionB: A non-member function granted access to private and protected members of a class
questions.optionC: A function belonging to an inherited child class
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A friend function is an external function explicitly allowed access to private and protected members of the declaring class.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to handle runtime exceptions in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Exception handling in C++ employs try, catch, and throw keywords together.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of an inline function in C++?
questions.optionA: To avoid function call overhead by substituting code directly at the call site
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Inline functions request compiler code substitution at the call location to bypass stack frame overhead.

questions.questionText: In C++, which function checks whether a given type is an array using type traits?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: std::is_array evaluates whether a type argument is an array type.

questions.questionText: Dynamic memory allocated using new operator in C++ is allocated from which memory segment?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 'new' operator dynamically allocates memory from the free store (heap).

questions.questionText: A constructor that takes a reference to an object of the same class is called a:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A copy constructor has the signature ClassName(const ClassName &obj) to duplicate an instance.

questions.questionText: Destructors in C++:
questions.optionC: Cannot take arguments and cannot be overloaded
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Destructors take no arguments, return no value, and cannot be overloaded.

questions.questionText: What is the scope of a local variable defined inside a code block { ... }?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Block-scoped variables are visible and valid only within the enclosing braces { }.

questions.questionText: Which of the following access specifiers allows members to be inherited and accessible in derived classes, but kept private to the outside world?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Protected members are accessible within the defining class and its derived classes, but inaccessible to outside callers.

questions.questionText: In C++, virtual functions enable which design paradigm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Virtual functions enable dynamic binding (late binding) for runtime polymorphism.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct syntax for single inheritance in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C++ declares inheritance using a colon followed by the access modifier and base class name.

questions.questionText: What happens if a derived class object is deleted using a base class pointer without a virtual destructor?
questions.optionA: Memory leak and undefined behavior (derived destructor will not be called)
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Deleting a derived object via a base pointer with a non-virtual destructor bypasses the derived destructor, causing resource leaks.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a non-linear data structure?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Trees and graphs organize data hierarchically or interconnectedly, making them non-linear data structures.

questions.questionText: What is the best-case time complexity of Bubble Sort when an optimized swapped flag is used?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: When the input array is already sorted, a single pass with no swaps terminates Bubble Sort in O(N) time.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is used to check for balanced parentheses in a mathematical expression?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A LIFO stack matches opening and closing parentheses in expressions.

questions.questionText: What is the average time complexity of searching in a Hash Table with good hashing?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: With an effective hash function and low load factor, search operations execute in average O(1) constant time.

questions.questionText: In a Singly Linked List, inserting a new node at the very beginning (head) requires time complexity of:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Inserting at the head requires updating only the new node's next pointer and head pointer, taking O(1) time.

questions.questionText: Which traversal of a Binary Search Tree (BST) visits nodes in strictly ascending sorted order?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Inorder traversal (Left, Root, Right) of a BST outputs elements in non-decreasing sorted order.

questions.questionText: The maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height $h$ (where root is at height 1) is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A complete binary tree of height h contains 2^0 + 2^1 + ... + 2^(h-1) = 2^h - 1 nodes.

questions.questionText: In a Max-Heap with $N$ elements, where is the maximum element stored?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The max-heap property guarantees that the largest element is stored at the root node.

questions.questionText: What algorithm is used to find the Single-Source Shortest Path in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's greedy algorithm computes single-source shortest paths in graphs with non-negative edge costs.

questions.questionText: What is the postfix conversion of the infix expression: A + B * C?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Multiplication has higher precedence than addition: B * C becomes BC*, and adding A gives ABC*+.

questions.questionText: QuickSort exhibits its worst-case performance of $O(N^2)$ when:
questions.optionA: The array elements are randomly shuffled
questions.optionB: The array is already completely sorted and the first or last element is chosen as pivot
questions.optionC: The pivot is always the median element
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Unbalanced partitions resulting from extreme pivot selection on sorted arrays cause O(N^2) behavior in QuickSort.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an NP-Complete problem?
questions.optionC: Finding shortest path using Breadth First Search in unweighted graph
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: BFS solves unweighted single-source shortest path problems in polynomial time O(V + E), so it is in class P.

questions.questionText: In a circular queue of capacity MAX_SIZE using an array, what condition detects that the queue is full?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A circular queue is full when advancing rear by one modulo array size meets the front index.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of deleting an element from the rear of a Double-ended Queue (deque) implemented using a Singly Linked List (with head and tail pointers)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In a singly linked list, locating the node immediately preceding the tail requires traversing from head, taking O(N) time.

questions.questionText: A matrix is termed a Sparse Matrix when:
questions.optionA: Majority of its elements are zero (number of zeros $> (m \times n)/2$)
questions.optionC: All elements are greater than zero
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A sparse matrix is characterized by having substantially more than half of its entries equal to zero.

questions.questionText: In the relational database model, a tuple is equivalent to a:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In formal relational model terminology, a tuple corresponds to an individual row or record.

questions.questionText: Which relational algebra operation extracts specific columns from a relation?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Projection (represented by π) filters attributes/columns from a relation.

questions.questionText: Which clause is used with the SQL SELECT statement to eliminate duplicate output rows?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The DISTINCT keyword removes duplicate rows from the query result set.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a Data Definition Language (DDL) command in SQL?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ALTER modifies the structure of database objects and is categorized under DDL.

questions.questionText: What is the function of the CASCADE option in a FOREIGN KEY constraint?
questions.optionA: Automatically deletes or updates referencing rows when the referenced parent row is deleted or updated
questions.optionB: Rejects the deletion of parent row
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ON DELETE/UPDATE CASCADE propagates deletions and updates from parent tables to child tables.

questions.questionText: A candidate key that is not selected as the primary key of a table is termed as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Candidate keys that remain unselected as the primary key are designated as alternate keys.

questions.questionText: Which normal form eliminates partial functional dependency on a composite primary key?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Second Normal Form (2NF) mandates that non-prime attributes are fully functionally dependent on candidate keys.

questions.questionText: In the ACID properties of database transactions, 'I' stands for:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In ACID properties, 'I' represents Isolation, ensuring concurrently executing transactions do not interfere with each other.

questions.questionText: What is the result of SELECT COUNT(*) on an empty table in SQL?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: COUNT(*) aggregates the total row count and returns 0 when evaluated on an empty table.

questions.questionText: The SQL clause WITH is utilized to:
questions.optionA: Create temporary named result sets (Common Table Expressions - CTE)
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The WITH clause creates temporary named result sets called Common Table Expressions (CTEs).

questions.questionText: In SQL pattern matching, which wildcard character matches any string of zero or more characters?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The percent sign (%) wildcard in SQL matches zero, one, or multiple characters in LIKE predicates.

questions.questionText: What is data redundancy in database systems?
questions.optionA: Unnecessary duplication of data across multiple tables
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Data redundancy occurs when the same data fields are stored redundantly in multiple places.

questions.questionText: What state does a running process enter when it executes an I/O system call?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A process transitions from running to waiting/blocked when awaiting I/O or an event.

questions.questionText: Which of the following CPU scheduling algorithms is completely non-preemptive?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: FCFS scheduling lets the allocated process run to completion without preemption.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT one of the four Coffman conditions necessary for a deadlock to occur?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The required condition is 'No Preemption'. Allowing preemption breaks the deadlock condition.

questions.questionText: Banker's Algorithm in operating systems is used for:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's Banker's algorithm tests for safe states to avoid deadlocks in resource allocation.

questions.questionText: The memory address generated directly by the CPU during program execution is known as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The CPU generates logical (virtual) addresses, which the MMU translates into physical addresses.

questions.questionText: Belady's Anomaly occurs in which page replacement algorithm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Belady's anomaly (more frame allocations resulting in more page faults) is observed in FIFO page replacement.

questions.questionText: What is the Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)?
questions.optionA: A special high-speed hardware cache used to store recent virtual-to-physical address translations
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The TLB is an associative hardware cache inside the MMU caching recent page table translations.

questions.questionText: In Linux/Unix systems, which system call creates a new exact copy of the calling process?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The fork() system call duplicates the parent process, creating a child process with an identical address space.

questions.questionText: Spooling (Simultaneous Peripheral Operations On-Line) is most commonly used in:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Spooling buffers incoming print jobs on disk to process them sequentially on shared printers.

questions.questionText: A semaphore initialized to 1 and used to enforce mutually exclusive access to critical sections is called a:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A binary semaphore operates between 0 and 1, functioning as a mutex lock for mutual exclusion.

questions.questionText: Which layer of the OSI reference model is responsible for end-to-end reliable data delivery, flow control, and error recovery?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Transport Layer (Layer 4) manages host-to-host flow control, error recovery, and reliable transmission.

questions.questionText: What is the standard subnet mask for a default Class C IPv4 address network?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Class C networks dedicate 24 bits to the network identifier, giving a default mask of 255.255.255.0 (/24).

questions.questionText: What protocol automatically assigns dynamic IP addresses and network configurations to host devices on a local network?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) automatically assigns IP addresses and network parameters to client devices.

questions.questionText: Which protocol resolves a known Logical IP address to a Physical MAC hardware address?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) translates Layer 3 IP addresses into Layer 2 MAC addresses.

questions.questionText: In HTML5, which tag is used to specify inline client-side vector graphics dynamically?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both <canvas> and <svg> are HTML5 elements used for client-side graphics rendering, making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Which coupling type is considered best practice and most desirable in modular software design?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Data coupling occurs when modules share only data parameters, representing the best loose-coupling practice.

questions.questionText: In Machine Learning, which of the following is an Unsupervised Learning algorithm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: K-Means clustering partitions unlabeled data into clusters without supervision, while Linear Regression and SVM are supervised.

questions.questionText: What is the language recognized by a Deterministic Finite Automaton (DFA)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: By definition in automata theory, the class of languages recognized by DFAs is the regular languages.
